native_offline_renderer_check.method: CPU-only offline native request parser and template render, using the retained image and cached original template; no inference or service changes

distinction: The native vLLM renderer preserves none and renders effort zero. The later Unsloth top-level-none bug renders 0.9; do not attribute that bug to the native run.
interpretation: The earlier native latency includes substantial reasoning-token generation despite the lowest requested effort. It is not a no-thinking baseline.
limits: Reasoning share of output tokens is not a measured share of wall time.
At the time of this retrospective audit, a same-native-runtime/checkpoint no-thinking replay had not yet been performed.
The newer no-thinking Cognee run also changes runtime, quantization and caching; its timing difference cannot isolate thinking cost.
The native agent recovered more relevant sources and the actual transition, so removing thinking cannot be assumed to preserve agent quality.

follow_up.interpretation: Subsequent paired native experiment measures thinking suppression on the same checkpoint and process; historical counts above are unchanged. Complete answers stayed 44/47, while fully grounded complete answers fell 44/47 to 43/47.
